text:
The first image fills me with a sense of separation—I observe a group gathered in a glass-walled room, possibly in discussion or at a seminar. I am on the outside, an onlooker to their communal engagement. This makes me feel curious but also somewhat isolated, as though I am witnessing a private world to which I do not belong.

Moving to the second image, I confront a brightly lit, thoughtfully designed wall about 'R + D'—research and development. This space feels intentional, cultivated for learning and curiosity. I sense a shift in mood: from observer of people to participant in a world of ideas, as if the space invites me to reflect and engage. There is promise here, a sense that something new is being discovered or created, and it makes me feel optimistic and intellectually stimulated.
